title: Ashiko Drum-Building Workshop
artifact_focus: L4 empirical packet — workshop-validated geometry, jig CAD, and assembly manual

cultural_provenance.claim: This packet documents a 2015 workshop that produced 16 physical ashiko drums. It does not claim to be a traditional craft authority; it documents engineering decisions made for a makerspace build context informed by Morgan Drums apprenticeship (Tony Koop, 2012–2014).

physical_design_anchors.dimension_basis: 18-stave shell; stave geometry from SolidWorks CAD
physical_design_anchors.authority_scope: stave geometry, jig CAD, and lathe fixture — from SolidWorks parts in CAD/; pitch measurements pending re-capture from builders

notes: Fabrication geometry (stave, sled, lathe fixture) is CAD-backed and workshop-validated.
Pitch data not recorded at workshop; validation.csv nominal rows only.
Drawing DXF exports not yet produced from SolidWorks originals (drawing-brief.md lists priority drawings).
Wolfram model is parametric estimate; membrane tension values are nominal, not measured.
